source: class Palette { public Color Tint = new(1, 1, 1, 0.5); }
interface IFoo { string Text { get; set; } }
class Person : IFoo { public string Text = ""; public string FirstName = "Ada"; public string LastName = "Lovelace"; public string Bound() { NeoDelegate<string> fn = this.EchoText; return fn(); } }
class Box<T> { public T Value; }
enum Weather { Sunny, Rainy }
extension int { int Twice() => this * 2; static int DefaultValue => 7; }
extension int? { int OrZero() => this ?? 0; }
extension List<int> { int Total() => this.Sum(); List<int> Sorted() { this.Sort((a, b) => a - b); return this; } }
extension<T> List<T> { T? FirstValue => this.FirstOrDefault(); }
extension<T> Box<T> { T Peek() => this.Value; }
extension Weather { bool IsSunny() => this == Weather.Sunny; }
extension Person { string EchoText() => this.Text; public string FullName => $"{this.FirstName} {this.LastName}"; string Alias { get => this.Text; set(string value) { this.Text = value; } } }
extension IFoo { void ToBar() { this.Text = "Bar"; } }
extension<T extends IFoo> T { string ReadText() => this.Text; }
extension (int A, int B) { int Total() => this.Item1 + this.Item2; }
extension NeoObject { bool Exists() => this != null; }
class Counter { public int Calls = 0; public int Next() { this.Calls += 1; return 4; } }
class DerivedPerson : Person {}
extension List<int> { void Sort() { this.Sort((a, b) => b - a); } }
extension int { int Fail() { throw "extension failure"; } }
extension string { NeoDelegate<int> Callback => () => 12; NeoDelegate<int, int> Split { get { throw "getter must not run"; } } }
extension Person? { bool Missing => this == null; }
extension<T extends IFoo> T { bool MatchesOther => Probe.Other is T; }
extension NeoError { string ReadMessage() => this.Message; }
extension Vector2 { float y => 99.0; float Sum => this.x + this.y; static int StaticRead => 17; }
extension Weather { static int Sunny => 99; }
extension bool { static int Read() => 19; }
extension string { static string Join(int number) => "extension"; }

extension Vector3 { static int MatrixProperty => 1; static int MatrixCall() => 2; }
extension Vector3Int { static int MatrixProperty => 1; static int MatrixCall() => 2; }

extension Weather { static int MatrixProperty => 1; static int MatrixCall() => 2; }

extension Color { float a => 99.0; }
extension SpriteInfo { int SliceIndex => 99; }
extension Person { string Id => "shadow"; }
extension (int A, int B) { int A => 99; int Difference => this.A - this.B; }
extension int { async int Later() => this.Twice(); }
class Item { public int Quality; }
extension List<Item> { Item? Best() => this.OrderByDescending((i) => i.Quality).FirstOrDefault(); }
class Base {} class Narrowed : Base, IFoo { public string Text = ""; }
extension Person { static string Badge() => "badge"; }
class CallbackHolder { public NeoDelegate<bool> Callback; }
extension Person? { bool IsAbsent() => this == null; CallbackHolder Capture() => new CallbackHolder { Callback = this.IsAbsent }; }
extension NeoRandom { static float Range(float min, float max) => 999.0; static int Seed { get => 999; set(int value) {} } }
class CallableBase {} class CallableDerived : CallableBase {}
extension CallableBase { int Read(int value) => value; }
extension CallableDerived { NeoDelegate<int, int> Read => (value) => value + 1; }
class CallableDeclared { public int Read(int value) => value; }
extension CallableDeclared { NeoDelegate<int, string> Read => (value) => value.Length; }
class Probe {
public static Person Other = new();
@storage(allowed: .Immutable) public static Person Frozen = new();
public static int Scalar() => 4.Twice();
public static int StaticProperty() => int.DefaultValue;
public static int Nullable() { int? value = null; return value.OrZero(); }
public static int ClosedCollection() { List<int> values = [1, 2, 3]; return values.Total(); }
public static int SortedCollection() { List<int> values = [3, 1, 2]; return values.Sorted()[0]; }
public static string GenericCollection() { List<string> values = ["first", "second"]; return values.FirstValue!; }
public static string GenericClass() { var value = new Box<string> { Value = "box" }; return value.Peek(); }
public static bool EnumReceiver() => Weather.Sunny.IsSunny();

public static int FullStaticMatrix() { int total = 0; total += Vector2Int.MatrixProperty; total += Vector2Int.MatrixCall(); total += Vector3.MatrixProperty; total += Vector3.MatrixCall(); total += Vector3Int.MatrixProperty; total += Vector3Int.MatrixCall(); total += Color.MatrixProperty; total += Color.MatrixCall(); total += SpriteInfo.MatrixProperty; total += SpriteInfo.MatrixCall(); total += AudioClipInfo.MatrixProperty; total += AudioClipInfo.MatrixCall(); total += List<int>.MatrixProperty; total += List<int>.MatrixCall(); total += Dictionary<string, int>.MatrixProperty; total += Dictionary<string, int>.MatrixCall(); total += Set<int>.MatrixProperty; total += Set<int>.MatrixCall(); total += Weather.MatrixProperty; total += Weather.MatrixCall(); total += Person.MatrixProperty; total += Person.MatrixCall(); return total; }
public static float ColorField() { Color value = new Palette().Tint; value.a = 0.75; return value.a; }
public static int SpriteField() => SpriteInfo.Empty.SliceIndex;
public static bool ClassIdField() => new Person().Id != "shadow";
public static int TupleFields() { (int A, int B) value = (5, 2); return value.A + value.Difference; }
public static async int DeferredCall() => 4.Later();
public static int BestItem() { List<Item> items = [new Item { Quality = 2 }, new Item { Quality = 9 }]; return items.Best()!.Quality; }
public static string NarrowedInterface() { Base value = new Narrowed(); if (value is IFoo) { value.ToBar(); return value.Text; } return "wrong"; }
public static string StaticMethodGroup() { NeoDelegate<string> fn = Person.Badge; return fn(); }
public static bool UnboundConstruction() { Person? person = null; return person.Capture().Callback != null; }
public static bool UnboundInvocation() { Person? person = null; return person.Capture().Callback(); }

public static bool RandomDeclaredWins() { NeoRandom.Seed = 123; float first = NeoRandom.Range(0.0, 1.0); NeoRandom.Seed = 123; return first == NeoRandom.Range(0.0, 1.0) && first != 999.0 && NeoRandom.Seed != 999; }
public static int DelegateSpecificity() => new CallableDerived().Read(3);
public static int DelegateApplicability() => new CallableDeclared().Read("hello");
public static bool NullExtensionGetter() { Person? p = null; try { var text = p!.Alias; } catch (NeoNullReferenceError error) { return true; } return false; }
public static bool NullExtensionSetter() { Person? p = null; try { p!.Alias = "changed"; } catch (NeoNullReferenceError error) { return true; } return false; }
